A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new SLAM method based on LiDAR data only, that is very accurate, robust and fast.
we propose a new SLAM algorithm that is able to handle long sequences of 3D LiDar data with very low drift, and without any loop closure.
we propose a SLAM solution based on 3D data only, with no loop closure, no feature extraction, no image processing, with a very low drift, and that is robust to noise.
The main takeaway from our work is that
LiDAR data can be used to perform SLAM without any loop closure, which is very useful in real-time and in large scale applications.
3D LiDar data can be used for odometry with low drift without any loop closure and without the need of an external map.
3D LiDAr data are sufficient for odometry and that the IMLS surface representation is very efficient for this problem.
